name: Futami Shion
source:
Shion is a girl who transferred into [url=/c7877]Tomoya[/url]'s class in the past semester. She has a calm personality, and prefers to be isolated. Like [url=/c7881]Kaoru[/url], Shion excels in language, and shows an interest in literature to the extent where she became a librarian.
[spoiler]She's 1/4 Finnish from her mother's side.[/spoiler]
translation:
Shion is a girl who transferred into [url=/c7877]Tomoya[/url]'s class in the past semester. She has a calm personality, and prefers to be isolated. Like [url=/c7881]Kaoru[/url], Shion excels in language, and shows an interest in literature to the extent where she became a librarian.
[spoiler]She's 1/4 Finnish from her mother's side.[/spoiler]
